name: XRPL
description: XRPL.org is a community-driven site for the XRP Ledger (XRPL), an open-source, public blockchain. Gain access to technical documentation, reference materials, and blockchain ledger tools.
longDescription: Xrpl is a decentralized public blockchain, driven by the XRPL developer community. It offers a range of benefits and features that make it an ideal choice for businesses. The XRP Ledger, maintained by a global community of software engineers, server operators, users, and businesses, is designed to solve problems and create real-world value. One key advantage of Xrpl is its consensus protocol, which ensures fast and secure transactions. Validators, operated by universities, exchanges, businesses, and individuals, come to an agreement on the order and outcome of transactions every three to five seconds. This decentralized approach guarantees the integrity of the system and ensures the ongoing decentralization of the blockchain. Unlike many other blockchains, Xrpl requires no mining and has negligible energy consumption, making it a sustainable choice for long-term growth and stability. With over 10 years of error-free functioning and enterprise companies as champions, Xrpl has proven reliability. Thousands of developers and businesses are already building innovative projects and applications across various blockchain use cases, such as tokenization of assets, online gaming, asset custody, NFTs, and DeFi. As a community-led blockchain, Xrpl attracts companies and developers committed to solving real problems and generating tangible value. With significant investment in development, low transaction costs, and energy usage, Xrpl is fueling growth and unlocking a wide range of use cases at scale. If you're ready to embark on your next big blockchain project, explore the XRPL now and consider applying for an XRPL Grant. The future of blockchain starts with you. Join the Xrpl community and be a part of the innovation and value creation it offers.
